root_cause.text: The function klsi_105_prepare_write_buffer passes the full buffer size (bulk_out_size) as the maximum copy length to kfifo_out_locked, but the destination starts KLSI_HDR_LEN bytes into the buffer, so copying size bytes overflows by KLSI_HDR_LEN bytes when the fifo contains at least size bytes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the call from `kfifo_out_locked(..., size, ...)` to `kfifo_out_locked(..., size - KLSI_HDR_LEN, ...)`, and the commit message states: "passes the full buffer size as the number of bytes to copy... When the fifo holds at least size bytes, size bytes are copied starting two bytes into the size-byte buffer, writing KLSI_HDR_LEN bytes past its end."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential buffer overflow by properly limiting the data copy size to account for the header length in klsi_105_prepare_write_buffer.
intent_record.what: Changed the third argument of kfifo_out_locked from 'size' to 'size - KLSI_HDR_LEN'.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the number of bytes copied from the write FIFO into the buffer does not exceed the available space after the header, preventing a buffer overflow.
